title: TOP ASSEMBLY & REAR LOCK
summary: Convertible (19467) soft top (folding top assembly) mounting and its rear lock: the top's side hinges bolt to the body brackets behind the doors, and at the rear center the top's rear bow carries a lock housing with a striker bolt that latches into a lock mounted through the folding top lid (the tonneau/top storage lid). The housing is screwed to the top over a shim; the lock is held to the lid by a cover and gasket with nuts. The top chart (item 1) lists the top assemblies by color.
